title: ConstructionOS Architecture Change Request record
description: Schema for every record in governance/acr/. One file per ACR, named <ID>.json (e.g. ACR-003.json). The ACR lifecycle is: PROPOSED -> ENDORSED (Architect review) -> APPROVED (Product Owner approval) -> IMPLEMENTED, with REJECTED as a terminal alternative. The validator enforces lifecycle coherence, role ownership, ordering and reference resolution; see spec/architecture-lock.md Section 3 (Architecture changes) and governance/README.md.

id.description: Canonical ACR identifier. Sequential: ACR-001 and ACR-002 are the historical markdown ACRs in governance/architecture-changes/; machine-readable records start at ACR-003. ACR-9xx is reserved for demo fixtures.

demo.description: true marks a demonstration fixture with synthetic references. Demo ACRs are excluded from real routing and may not be referenced by real work-item records.

disclaimer.description: Required when demo=true. States that the record is synthetic and makes no claim about real work.

status.description: Lifecycle status. PROPOSED: registered with full analysis. ENDORSED: Architect review recorded (verdict endorsed). APPROVED: Product Owner approval recorded after Architect endorsement. IMPLEMENTED: the approved change has landed via the referenced implementing work item. REJECTED: terminal.

requested_by.description: GitHub username or agent identifier that requested the change.

evidence.description: Evidence items backing the problem statement (issue references, CI runs, ledger facts).

affected_requirements.description: Requirement IDs from spec/requirements.md (or subordinate product registries) affected by this change. Every ID must resolve.

affected_work_items.description: Work-item IDs whose governance is affected. Every ID must resolve to a registered work-item record (non-demo for real ACRs).

architecture_version_from.description: Architecture version the change applies to. Must be registered in governance/architecture-versions.json.

architecture_version_to.description: Architecture version the change produces. Equal to _from for control changes that do not create a new version; different values create a new immutable version that must be registered once the ACR is APPROVED (spec/architecture-lock.md Section 3).

authorized_paths.description: Exact repository paths this ACR authorizes changing while it is APPROVED or IMPLEMENTED, used by check-protected --acr routing. Paths must be unique. An approved ACR only routes the exact paths it enumerates; everything else stays protected.

role.description: Only the Architect records ACR review.

review.description: Architect review of the request. Required from ENDORSED onwards. Must precede the Product Owner approval.

role.description: Only the Product Owner authorizes architecture changes.

approval.description: Product Owner approval. Required from APPROVED onwards.

work_item.description: The work item that implemented this ACR. That record must reference this ACR in its acr field (bidirectional integrity).

implementation.description: Implementation tracking. Required for IMPLEMENTED status.

related_issue.description: GitHub issue carrying the request, when one exists.

provenance.description: Optional note documenting where the request originated (e.g. an earlier markdown proposal commit).
